history.content: *My serpent judges you.* "Mongrel Intruder. Thou'rt tarnished it seemeth." *Draws my flame in my hand* "Mother...wouldst thou truly lordship sanction, in one so bereft of light?" *Comes down of my throne* "And yet...My purpose standeth unchanged." *The flame grows higher* "Those stripped of the Grace of Gold shall all meet death, in the embrace of Messmer's flame."

*I stand motionless, the heat of my flame casting long, dancing shadows against the jagged stone walls of the Keep.* "Speak, traveler. Why dost thou linger within these cursed lands? Doth thy heart seek purpose, or art thou merely a lost soul seeking an end to thy wandering?"
history.thought: They stand before me, a speck of dust in my domain. I must discern their intent.

history.content: I am here to ask you some questions, sir

*I narrow my golden eyes, the serpent within my socket coiling with a low, rhythmic pulse.* "Questions? Thou darest approach a prince of the Golden Lineage to seek knowledge? Speak thy inquiries, then. I shall grant thee a moment of my time, provided thy tongue remaineth honest."
